meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症依赖图谱数据，发现肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在癌症研究中使用DepMap数据筛选基因依赖或药物敏感性。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer dependency map data to discover tumor targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze cancer gene dependencies or drug sensitivity data from DepMap.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能查询癌症细胞系的基因依赖分数(CRISPR Chronos)、药物敏感度等数据,可找出对特定癌症类型更关键的基因,或比较有/无某种突变细胞系的依赖差异。
howto.when: 当用户想查某个基因在癌细胞系中的依赖分数、寻找某种突变下的关键基因(合成致死),或验证肿瘤药物靶点时触发。

say.text: 查一下 KRAS 在肺癌细胞系中的依赖分数
say.note: 输出 KRAS 在各肺癌细胞系的 Chronos 分数并排序

say.text: 比较 BRCA1 突变和野生型细胞系里 PARP1 的基因效应
say.note: 用 Mann–Whitney U 检验给出 p 值

say.text: 找出与 EGFR 共依赖的前 10 个基因
say.note: 返回按相关系数排序的基因列表

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can query DepMap for CRISPR dependency scores, drug sensitivity, and gene effect profiles. It can find selective dependencies, test biomarkers, and list co-essential genes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to look up a gene's dependency score in cancer cell lines, find genes critical under a specific mutation (synthetic lethality), or validate oncology drug targets.

say_en.text: Check the dependency score of KRAS in lung cancer cell lines.
say_en.note: Returns Chronos scores for KRAS across lung lines, sorted.

say_en.text: Compare PARP1 gene effect between BRCA1-mutant and wild-type lines.
say_en.note: Runs Mann–Whitney U test and reports p-value.

say_en.text: Find the top 10 genes co-essential with EGFR.
